DisplayName: Floor 2 — swarm wave with ranged threat introduced
Description: Floor 2's balanced-path retinue (50 units, 20% Archers, per scaling-curve.md's growth curve) against the locked floor-2 population of 450, which for the first time includes Soldier-ranged (20% of the population) alongside Fodder and Soldier-melee.
